# Nearby Escape Rooms

> An imported escape-room location directory undergoing current venue-source review.

## Current dataset

- 498 records contain names and coordinates.
- 261 records contain a city; 237 do not.
- The data represents 47 states.
- Every record has the same generic `Group activity` and `Indoor` labels.
- No record stores the original source, collection date, official website, phone, street address, room lineup, age policy, group size, price, hours, availability, booking link, accessibility, rating, or review date.

## Indexing and monetization

- The homepage and trust pages may be indexed.
- Browse, state, and record routes remain noindex while the imported data is rebuilt.
- Bulk imported pages are not monetization-ready.
- Advertising, analytics, affiliate links, and newsletter capture are not active.

## Publication standard

A future reviewed profile must cite a current official venue source, record what was reviewed and when, distinguish venue-published facts from editorial guidance, and clearly identify whether an outbound booking link is official or from an authorized seller.
